protocol: as scripts/finetune_cic2017.py (same split seeds, budgets, schedules); decision-rule variants: orig, budget_T, no_T, strict

variants.orig: T on <=100k labelled 2017 calibration flows; threshold on benign alarm-cal flows
variants.budget_T: T on the labelled budget only (in-sample); threshold on benign alarm-cal flows
variants.no_T: T = 1; threshold on benign alarm-cal flows
variants.strict: T and 5% threshold both from the labelled budget only (in-sample)

matched_far: dr_at_test_far_*: DR at the threshold that gives exactly that FAR on test benign (oracle comparison view)
